name: escapebase44
description: EscapeBase44 migrates a Base44 app off Base44, with its backend, database, users and files, onto hosting you own.
long_description: EscapeBase44 migrates a Base44 app off Base44 as it is, with its backend, database, users and files, onto hosting you own. EscapeBase44 is a Base44 migration service: the migration runs at escapebase44.com and nothing in the app gets rebuilt. This MCP server, CLI and agent skill only describe EscapeBase44 and point to escapebase44.com; the migration itself runs there.
